entities.summary: Manuel Frederick was an Indian field hockey player who played as goalkeeper from Kannur district in Kerala. He won a bronze medal at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich. He was the first Keralite to win an Olympic medal. The second Keralite to win an Olympic medal is P. R. Sreejesh who won a bronze on 5th August 2021 in Tokyo Olympics. Both medals for Kerala have come via the goalkeepers of the National Hockey Team.
